title: Buying a used truck with high mileage - my experience
body: I recently bought a 2007 Ford F-150 with 180k miles on it. I was hesitant at first, but the price was right and the seller seemed legit. After taking it for a spin, I noticed some rough idling and uneven acceleration. A mechanic friend of mine took a look under the hood and found some worn-out belts and a few leaking gaskets. It's been a bit of a money pit so far, but I'm hoping to get some decent years out of it.

title: Buying a Used Truck at 100k Miles - A Cautionary Tale
body: I recently bought a used Ford F-150 with 100k miles on it. The truck has been great, but I've learned to be cautious about the condition of the engine and transmission. I had some issues with the starter motor being slow to engage, which turned out to be a wornout solenoid. I also noticed some oil leaks around the valve cover gasket. These issues were easily fixed, but they made me realize that even high-mileage trucks can have problems if not properly maintained.
